name: MeeMee Station
about: Number bonds within 10 on the class's ten frame and bar model: the MeeMee come aboard a space station. planet: 4 is the space station; badge: the station in a round night window (art.py); say: the line said when its place is tapped; scripts: facts.js is the facts, how secure each is and how rounds are chosen, draw.js the station and its hull modules (the mock-up's approved drawing), moments.js the crew's job moments, game.js the game (its three steps and its grown-ups tab, Station).
